'''Takemiakura-no-Mikoto''' (''takemiakura no mikoto''; dates of birth and death unknown) was a {{ill|gōzoku|ja|豪族}} of the {{ill|Kofun period|ja|古墳時代}} and the first '''{{ill|Ōita no Kuni no Miyatsuko|ja|大分国造}}'''.

== Overview ==
In the "Tenson Hongi" of the ''{{ill|Sendai Kuji Hongi|ja|先代旧事本紀}}'', he is placed as a child of {{ill|Taketsuyone-no-Mikoto|ja|建斗米命}}, ancestor of the {{ill|Owari clan|ja|尾張氏}} ({{ill|Owari no Kuni no Miyatsuko|ja|尾張国造}}), and is recorded as ancestor of the '''Takaya-Ōita no Kuni no Miyatsuko'''.

== Genealogy ==
According to the "Tenson Hongi" of the ''{{ill|Sendai Kuji Hongi|ja|先代旧事本紀}}'', his father was {{ill|Taketsuyone-no-Mikoto|ja|建斗米命}}, and his siblings were {{ill|Takeunabi-no-Mikoto|ja|健宇那比命}}, {{ill|Takeda-no-Se-no-Mikoto|ja|建田背命}}, {{ill|Taketaori-no-Mikoto|ja|建多乎利命}}, {{ill|Takemarini-no-Mikoto|ja|建麻利尼命}}, {{ill|Taketewani-no-Mikoto|ja|建手和邇命}}, and {{ill|Unabi-hime-no-Mikoto|ja|宇那比姫命}}.<ref>"Tenson Hongi" of the ''{{ill|Sendai Kuji Hongi|ja|先代旧事本紀}}''.</ref>
